title: Exam stem method
topic: SAA/TD stem anatomy: story vs force words, distractor types, decode-before-options
format: 20 timed questions (~32 min, ~96 sec each). Underline force words before picking. Pair with the night guide.
answerDistribution: A x5 B x5 C x5 D x5

questions.question: First step on a Tutorials Dojo-style stem?

options.A: Cross out the company/industry story and underline force words
options.B: Diagram every service the company might ever need
options.C: Pick the service you used most in labs
options.D: Always choose Amazon S3 when storage is mentioned

questions.question: Which phrase is force-word gold, not story noise?

options.A: without passing through the public Internet and without NAT
options.B: The company plans to announce a product
options.D: hundreds of thousands of clients each day

questions.question: Distractor type: GuardDuty offered when stem needs to block SQLi on ALB.
Distractor type: IAM role on EC2 but IAM DB authentication never enabled.
BEST prediction order before reading options?

options.A: Predict the service from force words, then confirm
options.B: Scan all four options for the longest sentence
options.C: Search the stem for the word Amazon and match it

questions.question: "MOST cost-effective" with global login latency usually kills which pattern?

options.B: Redeploy full stacks in many Regions + latency routing

questions.question: Select TWO questions usually require what?

options.B: Two services that each map to different force words
options.C: Any two services from the same product family
options.D: S3 plus whatever else is listed

questions.question: Encryption at rest as the answer to private path, no Internet is which distractor?
Which ask-word changes how you compare options?
After a miss, the highest-value note is?

options.A: Memorize the correct letter for that PDF
options.B: The force word you skipped and the distractor type
options.C: The company industry in the stem
options.D: How long the explanation page was

questions.question: API Gateway will automatically handle spikes so do nothing is which distractor type?
Workload hint vs force word — which is only a hint?

options.A: must remain available if an AZ fails

questions.question: When should you read the four options first?

options.B: Never read options; guess from stem length
options.C: Only after underlining force words and predicting
options.D: Only the option that mentions Lambda

questions.question: A stem says minimize development changes for a Windows .NET app. Predicting EKS Fargate refactor is wrong because?

options.C: It violates the minimize-change force word (too much change)

questions.question: Which pair is the correct method card sequence start?

options.A: Options first, then story, then lab memory
options.B: Google each acronym in the stem
options.C: Cross out story, underline force words, name family

questions.question: Force-word family for POSIX + concurrent mounts?
Force-word family for within seconds vs few minutes?
Why Company X migration stories feel unlike GSA labs?

options.A: They test different AWS products that do not exist
options.C: Labs never cover networking or databases
options.D: They grade constraint decoding more than build familiarity

questions.question: If two options both look plausible, what breaks the tie?

options.D: Which option satisfies EVERY underlined force word

questions.question: Night 36-39 exist to do what after tonight?

options.B: Replace all S3 usage with EFS
options.D: Apply the same stem method on storage, DB, security, compute maps
